description: A plain-language growth brief for your own product: the single most important insight, 2-4 wins, 2-4 risks and 3-6 concrete next actions — grounded in your real post history plus whatever analytics (GA4, Search Console, PostHog) and fleet analysis you have synced. It changes nothing of yours, but it is not free: billed like the dashboard's own Growth Brief button, from your workspace's plan AI credits rather than your personal MCP credits. Use when the user asks how their product's social presence is doing and what to do next.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.
